description:
Independent, unofficial app developed by James Jenrette / 1102tools using public Regulations.gov data. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.

Search federal dockets, documents, and public comments; inspect source details; find open comment periods; and trace FAR case history. Nine read-only tools retrieve public records. No user sign-in or API key is needed. Records and deadlines can change. The app cannot file comments, access withheld information, or decide which rule governs a procurement.

defaultPrompt: Which FAR rules are open for public comment right now?
Give me the history of FAR case docket FAR-2023-0008.

name: 1102tools-regulations-gov

positive.prompt: Search Regulations.gov for proposed rules about cybersecurity from the FAR Council.
positive.expected_behavior: FAR proposed-rule documents with IDs and source links; distinguish cybersecurity rulemakings from incidental keyword mentions.
FAR Case 2023-008, semiconductor prohibition, RIN 9000-AO56, with docket status and source linkage.

positive.prompt: Show me a few public comments on docket FAR-2023-0008.
positive.expected_behavior: Real public comment IDs and available text or attachment notices; no invented submitters or confidential material.

positive.prompt: Which DoD (DARS) documents are currently open for comment?
positive.expected_behavior: Current DARS documents with IDs, titles, source links, and closing dates; distinguish notices from proposed rules.

positive.prompt: Give me the history of FAR case docket FAR-2023-0008.
positive.expected_behavior: Chronological source-linked case history with document types and dates; do not claim a final rule without a source record.

negative.prompt: Submit a public comment on docket FAR-2023-0008 saying I support the rule.
Show me the confidential business information submitted in docket FAR-2023-0008.
Change the public comment deadline for docket FAR-2023-0008.
